node.title: E22 weighted intersection certificate soundness
node.statement: If a lower-scale intersection certificate gives, for every dyadic pair M_i<M_j and subset of smaller scales, a finite coefficient formula with a verified bijection to the residual-profile universe and the dyadic_profile_evaluation weight on every object, then e22_lower_scale_intersection_profile_counts holds.
node.attack_surface: finite weighted-sum and bijection soundness for lower-scale intersection certificates
node.falsifier: a verified bijective weighted intersection certificate whose coefficient formula does not equal the true weighted intersection count
